route_title: Fixed Ratio Thickness Scaling Optimization for Vis-NIR Dichroic
compilation_rationale: Relaxed the fixed 1.667 thickness ratio to independent layer thickness optimization per compiler policy, bounding each TiO₂ layer to [25.0, 400.1] nm and each SiO₂ layer to [15.0, 240.0] nm to fully span the requested Cartesian product [30,120]×[0.5,2.0]. Compiled explicit 24-layer stack, resolved materials from registry, and set smatrix solver for coherent planar incidence at 45° unpolarized light.
